sources.snippet: Model Card for diffusion Diffusion Policy treats visuomotor control as a generative diffusion process, producing smooth, multi-step action trajectories that excel at contact-rich manipulation. This policy has been trained and pushed to the Hub using LeRobot. See the full documentation at LeRobot Docs.
